subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The hall is spacious and can accommodate (1)/ large number of guests (2)/ attending the conference (3)/ next month. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. large number of guests .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "large number of guests"** is incorrect because "large number" is used with countable nouns, and "guests" is a countable noun.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "a large number of guests."**
 
• Articles such as "a" are necessary to make the sentence grammatically accurate.

Correct sentence: *The hall is spacious and can accommodate a large number of guests attending the conference next month.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Understanding Article Usage:**
 
 
• "A" is used before singular, countable nouns to indicate one or any.
 
• "The" is used when referring to specific items.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Omitting articles can lead to grammatical inaccuracies.
 
• Using incorrect articles can alter the intended meaning of the sentence.
